name: Titterpig cross-edition bridges
note: A .bridge (spec §21) is the one container with TWO dependency lineages: it records a DIRECTED, third-party assertion of correspondence between two independent edition namespaces. It belongs to NEITHER edition and must never live inside either edition's corpus directory — its ORIGIN names would not resolve there and its presence would pollute that namespace. Validate with the two-corpus mode: ttrpg_validator.py 0.4/ --corpus <edition>=<dir> ...

sources.description: The RICH case: entity-keyed throughout. 573 MAPs, 7 REMAINDERs, 85 GUIDANCE entries, the document's own four-tag disposition vocabulary.

origin.external: No titterpig corpus exists for Ars Magica Fourth Edition (Atlas Games, 1996).

sources.description: The SPARSE case: ~85% prose, no entity-mapping table. No MAP, no REMAINDER, no DISPOSITIONS (the document declares no change-tag vocabulary, so none is invented). 7 field-level PROCEDUREs + 11 GUIDANCE entries.
